# monotaur_calendar_event (Data Source)

Reads a single Monotaur calendar event by its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "monotaur_calendar_event" "release_4_2" {
  id = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the calendar event to look up.

### Read-Only

- `create_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the event was created.
- `description` (String) A longer description of the event, or null.
- `end_date_time` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp (UTC) when the event ends.
- `external_reference` (String) A reference to an external record such as a ticket or change request, or null.
- `label_ids` (List of String) IDs of labels attached to the event.
- `start_date_time` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp (UTC) when the event starts.
- `title` (String) The title of the event.
- `update_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the event was last updated.
